decisive_spans.text: Histopathological examination:     - Epidermal ulceration overlying a diffuse dermal proliferation composed of sheets of histiocytes with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm    - Intracytoplasmic Michaelis-Gutmann bodies present as basophilic, somewhat laminated intracytoplasmic inclusion bodies measuring 5-8 μm in diameter
Two symmetrical solitary erythematous nodules were present in the right and left inguinal folds adjacent to the scrotum

response.rationale: The histopathological findings, specifically the presence of Michaelis-Gutmann bodies and sheets of histiocytes, are pathognomonic for Malakoplakia. While E. coli was cultured, it is a common finding in malakoplakia and not the primary diagnosis.
